sentences.text: Sinocyamodus is an extinct placodont reptile found in the Xiaowa Formation of China during the Late Triassic.
This animal belongs to the class Reptilia.
It is classified within the family Cyamodontidae.
Sinocyamodus was the first placodont discovered in the eastern Tethys, challenging the previous belief that these reptiles were only found in the western Tethys.
A 2018 report of an adult specimen revealed morphological differences from sub-adults, indicating significant developmental changes with age.
The genus Sinocyamodus was described by Li in the year 2000.
The type species of the genus is Sinocyamodus xinpuensis.
Fossils of Sinocyamodus date to the Late Triassic (Tuvalian) stage.
The time range for Sinocyamodus is the Carnian stage, between 233.6 and 227.3 million years ago.
